notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.notes:
In the multiplayer mode:
[list]
[*] Chat added. By default it can be opened by the hotkey ~
[*] Added the ability to grab all items from the guest's inventory. If you played with a friend and he has something useful in the inventory, but at the moment he can not connect to the game to give it, you can take it by yourself. Run the world in the singleplayer mode (NOT multiplayer), press Escape and select "Remote Players"
[*] Increased the maximum distance between players when they are on the base
[*] Now when the team dies, only those players who actually died are fined
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.18
notes.notes:
[h1]Added support of DirectX version 11[/h1]
This version is recommended for Windows 10 users who have problems with stability. To start the game with DirectX 11, click the "Play" button in Steam and select "Force of Nature (DirectX 11)". You can check the current version of DirectX the game video settings.
